source_metadata.title: Dapagliflozin and Acute Kidney Injury Following Cardiac Surgery: A Randomized Clinical Trial

consistency_findings.detail: Methods prose on page 3 transposes the MACE30 and MAKE30 composite definitions. Table 2 footnotes and the Limitations section use MACE30 for cardiovascular events and MAKE30 for kidney events. Normalized atoms follow Table 2.
The composite AKI benefit is concentrated in urine-output-defined AKI. Creatinine-only AKI was 14% versus 15% (RR 0.93), while urine-output-only AKI was 21% versus 48% (RR 0.44).
The main article refers to Supplement 3 for study-group members and Supplement 4 for the data-sharing statement. The Drive packet contains Supplement 1 and Supplement 2 only.

extraction_limitations: Supplement 1 uses a PDF font encoding that prevents reliable direct text extraction. Protocol claims used in atoms were limited to visually verified study-detail content.
No study-level details were invented. External perioperative guidance was not converted into LiteratureAtom objects.
